title: The finder wall strips the evidence bundles.json cites, so D15's universe enumerator refuses in every finder tree
claim: After tools/audit/prepare_baseline.sh --strip <tree> 11, `tools/audit/enumerate.py d15-installs` refuses (exit 2) on a tree where it printed 1 line before the strip, because strip_earlier_rounds keeps only round files cited by tests/closures.json or tests/*.py|mjs|sh and bundles.json's evidence path is neither.
mechanism: strip_earlier_rounds' keep set (closures + literal paths in tests/*) and enumerate.py:d15's existence requirement on bundles.json[].evidence are two definitions of which earlier-round files a finder tree must hold; the D15 brief names `enumerate.py d15-installs` as the universe, so the seat whose dimension it is cannot enumerate it in its own tree (observed in this seat's export: REFUSE ... round10/D15/s1/intake.py is not in the tree). Of the 19 universes enumerate.py serves, only d15-installs refuses in the walled export.

evidence.machine: macOS arm64, box B8 (shared), CI venv python3
evidence.contention_note: shared box, other finder seats running; counts are contention-immune

perturbation.change: --cite-in-tests: plant one tests/*.py citing the evidence path (the strip's own keep rule)

null_control.note: the evidence's own round is not stripped, so the enumerator answers

metric_definition: Lines enumerate.py d15-installs prints in a planted tree after prepare_baseline.sh --strip; -1 when it refuses.
phenomenon_property: Every path an enumerate.py universe requires to exist survives the finder wall that prepares the tree the universe's dimension runs in.
seam_rule: for each universe U in enumerate.py's docstring: bash tools/audit/prepare_baseline.sh --strip <copy> <round> && python3 tools/audit/enumerate.py U --repo <copy> (exit 2 = a seam); at the baseline only d15-installs
proposed_fix_scope: Keep dev/audit/config/*.json-cited evidence paths in strip_earlier_rounds' keep set (one more glob beside tests/*), or have enumerate.py d15 read the evidence from git when the tree is walled; either way a self-test arm in prepare_baseline.sh --strip-self-test planting a bundles.json citation.
reproduction_steps: python3 tools/audit/enumerate.py d15-installs (in the finder export): REFUSE
